text.en: On a holiday the local market is full of people. The toys in a toy shop hope that someone will pick them. Some customers pass by, but a girl chooses Snakes and Ladders, a boy asks his Aayi for a Vande Bharat toy train, two girls take marbles and an aeroplane, and a group of children take an elephant, a spinning top and dancing dolls. This chapter also teaches describing words and plurals.

It is a holiday and the toy shop opens at 9 a.m. It has wooden toys, soft toys, board games, bats and balls and many others. All the toys wait to see who will buy them. Two girls pass by and only look through the window, and the toys sigh. A girl, a little boy and their father stop. The girl chooses the board game Snakes and Ladders. A woman and her son come in. The boy asks his Aayi, which means mother, for the Vande Bharat toy train, and she buys it. Two girls buy marbles and a toy aeroplane. A group of children then take a toy elephant, a spinning top and dancing dolls. The toys are happy when someone chooses them, just as we are happy when we get something we like.
Toys in India are made in many places. Chennapatna toys are wooden toys from Karnataka, and Kondapalli dancing dolls come from Andhra Pradesh. The picture glossary shows a doll, Chennapatna toys, a Vande Bharat train, Kondapalli dancing dolls and a soft toy elephant.
Displayed means put out where people can see it, as toys are in a shop. Excitement is a feeling of great happiness while waiting for something. Eagerly means with great interest and wanting something very much.
The words boy, doll, frock and cap are naming words. The word happy tells us more about the boy. Words that tell more about a naming word are describing words. In a happy boy, a pretty doll, a blue frock and a red cap, happy, pretty, blue and red are describing words. For example, we can say a yellow mango, clean water, cold water, a brown paper, a large tree and a white kurta.
When there is more than one thing, we use a plural word. Plural means more than one. For most words we add s: cat becomes cats, cup becomes cups, doll becomes dolls, shop becomes shops and train becomes trains. For words ending in x, s, ch, sh or o we add es: box becomes boxes, class becomes classes, bus becomes buses, pouch becomes pouches, brush becomes brushes and mango becomes mangoes.

problem.en: Make the plural of brush and doll.

text.en: Brush ends in sh.
Doll ends in l.
Brushes and dolls.

problem.en: Find the describing word in: a pretty doll.

text.en: Doll names a thing.
Pretty tells how the doll looks.
So pretty is the describing word.

why.en: It tells more about the doll.

prompt.en: Tell the story of the toy shop in a few sentences.

requiredIdeas.en: Boy asks for Vande Bharat toy
Children buy elephant, top and dolls

commonMisconceptions.en: Nobody came to the toy shop

points.en: The toys in the shop wait to be chosen.
Describing words tell more about naming words.
Add s to make most plurals and es to words like box and bus.
Chennapatna and Kondapalli toys are traditional Indian toys.
